value: Yotsuba Framework documentation — setup, compatibility and rendering workflow.
A practical starting point for bringing an XNA or MonoGame project to Yotsuba Framework — from the first reference to the Metal render path.
API names and setup commands will evolve as the framework matures.
Open an issue or start a discussion in the project repository.
Yotsuba is designed to sit where an XNA-shaped game framework sits: your game owns the loop and content, while the framework supplies the platform and graphics implementation.

# Add the framework to your game project dotnet add package Yotsuba.Framework # Build content with the MonoGame pipeline dotnet mgcb /@:Content/Content.mgcb # Run the Apple target dotnet run --project Platforms/Apple
Note: Package names and CLI entry points are placeholders while the public distribution is being finalized.
